title: At Last | Stately 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: At Last is a luxury, pet-friendly WaterColor retreat with a private pool, golf cart, bikes, lake access, and full Beach Club and Camp WaterColor amenities.
description_expanded: At Last Features - Luxurious design - inside and out! - In the idyllic Lake District of Watercolor, and perfectly located to stroll to your event location at the Boat House, LakeHouse, Western Lake Park, and Marina Park - Complimentary access to a 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart)- some restrictions apply and must sign waiver to use cart during your stay - 6 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 1min bike ride to Frog Pool, Sandhill Park, and Western Lake Bridge. - Bike to the WaterColor Beach Club and beach access in minutes! Enjoy easy access to the serene WaterColor walking trails - Large Private Pool with sundeck and plenty of outdoor lounge seating. The pool can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Sonos Speakers poolside - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Pets not allowed in the pool. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Fenced-in backyard oasis surrounded by lush greenery and natural flora! - Covered Poolside Patio with TV, fireplace, and cushioned seating - Poolside Beach supply closet with 2-Seater Bote Kayak, 2 Bote Paddle Boards, Multiple Beach Chairs, and beach towels. - One of several WaterColor boat docks at Western Lake located two blocks from the home. Perfect spot to launch the kayaks and paddle boards to explore WaterColor and Western Lake. - Lots of porch space - Deluxe kids suite taking up the entire top floor, with sleeping for 5 and a game table featuring ping pong plus pool - Open-concept living area with tall ceilings - Gourmet stainless-steel kitchen with high-end appliances, marble counters, and plenty of cabinet storage. - Beverage chiller at the kitchen - Breakfast Bar for 5 - Dining Area for 8 - 1st Floor Living Room with spacious seating area, ceiling fan, comfy furniture, and SmartTV - Lots of lounge seating. Everyone has their own space to unwind! - 2nd floor Lounge with private workspace. Perfect private place for remote work! Cable and WIFI available throughout the home - Peaceful Bedrooms with plush cotton bedding, TVs, and high-end finishes! - Beautiful balcony views of the magnificent surrounding WaterColor trails, wildlife and sparkling private pool. - Driveway Parking for 3 Sedans or 2 oversized vehicles - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools included for 14 guests ages 5 and older. - Community pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available at the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor (subject to change by the neighborhood). - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, beach service, baby equipment rentals, private chef, and catered beach bonfires. Nestled in the picturesque Lake District of WaterColor, this jaw-dropping, pet-friendly home is a true luxury gem! Boasting a prime location and lavish interior design, it offers the perfect place to spend your beach getaway. Take a refreshing dip in the lush backyard oasis and get that golden tan by the large private pool with spa and sundeck! Plenty of outdoor spaces to lounge - no need to go far to enjoy the 30a weather. Get around with ease in the 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart) and Taxi Bikes! Perfect for entertaining, featuring a pool-side outdoor lounge with a TV and fireplace plus plenty of seating for al fresco dining or chatting! Located just minutes from the Western Lake Bridge, Frog Pool, and Sandhill Park, this home is perfectly placed in a location for exploring all that WaterColor has to offer. And with its prime location and luxury amenities, it's the perfect place to create lasting memories with family and friends. Having a WaterColor wedding or attending an event in WaterColor? This home is perfectly located to stroll to WaterColor event spaces like Western Lake Park, the Boat House, the LakeHouse, and Marina Park. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
